sections.title: Illustrative method guide

sections.body: Standardized one-contract comparisons and executable-account results are separate. Observed fills and known signals are lower-information saved counts, with unknown original/second fills and unknown outcomes displayed alongside them. Total account net is unavailable when capital or later outcomes are unknown; a known completed-only total does not fill that gap. Post-loss financial recovery requires a genuinely executed original leg to be flat, its realized net loss known at the later signal, and combined executed-leg net after both costs. Price returning to a range level does not prove financial recovery. Whole-contract quantity skips do not justify fractional contracts or larger capital.

sections.body: The capacity CSV conditions on the observed range certificate and frozen initial capital. It preserves both directions and full/half budget quantities, risk, leverage/margin constraints and skip reasons. It is a static initial-capital audit, not an executable account equity curve or a bound on missing future candidate prices.
sections.title: Static range-price capacity certificate

sections.body: Intervals are saved block-resampling outputs with prespecified block-length sensitivity. Primary-family adjusted intervals are marginal contrasts within each reported cohort; they do not provide simultaneous coverage across all year/session/side cohorts. Protected adjusted intervals apply only to the upper-first prespecified family; mirror and combined views are unadjusted exploratory evidence. Empty cohorts and undefined profit factors/rates remain unavailable. The most recent calendar year is partial. Costs are frozen assumptions, not broker fees. Fixed broker time and New York reporting time differ. Missing minutes, stale source stretches, estimated intrabar order and contract transitions limit exact execution inference. Native TradingView equivalence is unverified. Phase 3 and H10 remain uncomputed.
